summary: Steering briefing for the One Group, Many Practices programme, September 2026. Records completed HR consolidation for firms A to F, partial price harmonisation, firm F's brand migration, open SharePoint and LIMS items, and the plan to hold Osterquill apart until its archive and quality mapping are complete. Written by the Integration Director for the steering group.

properties.title: One Group, Many Practices: steering briefing, September 2026
properties.subject: Integration programme steering update
properties.keywords: One Group Many Practices, steering, integration, September 2026, Tarnovell

slides.title: One Group, Many Practices
slides.subtitle:
Steering briefing, September 2026
Sofia Lindervik, Integration Director

slides.title: Purpose of this session
bullets: Confirm where each workstream stands at the end of the third quarter
Agree the position on price harmonisation before the next group commercial review
Confirm how the Osterquill archive will be held apart until access and QA mapping are complete
Record the decisions needed from steering members before the Osterquill completion date
slides.notes: Status is taken from the workstream owners' September returns. Items marked open have not been closed, even where progress has been made.

rows: Three of six integrated firms mapped; historical local currencies and discounts retained
A to E on the common master; F completing; G legacy
Common export dictionary agreed; local accession numbers retained; cutover dates open
Client identity bridge in progress; subsidiary and lookalike checks required
Directory consolidated; G payroll onboarding not started
Local shares preserved as archive roots; leaver folder ownership checks open
Completes 1 October 2026; archive held apart pending access and QA mapping

slides.title: Price harmonisation
bullets: Local service names, list prices and currencies are mapped for Vellacombe, Brindlewythe and Merrivoss
Quenverell, Westravelle and Durnesswick comparisons are not yet complete and remain marked [TBC] in the working file
Historical discounts are being kept as recorded for each firm rather than netted off to a group rate
The normalisation assumptions still need sign-off from group finance before any proposed group service codes are used in quotes
slides.notes: The working workbook (v4) is the reference. Do not quote from the group codes until the normalisation assumptions are signed off.

slides.title: Brand migration
bullets: Firms A to E are on the common master template and brand guide
Firm F, Durnesswick, is completing its migration; the remaining items are mostly legacy report headers and two signature blocks
Firm G, Osterquill, remains on its own legacy brand until it joins the group, and nothing is to be restyled before the archive has been reviewed
Client-facing documents already issued keep their original branding, as agreed at the 2020 launch

slides.title: HR and payroll
bullets: The directory is consolidated for firms A to F and reporting lines in the HR system match the current organisation chart
Payroll for firms A to F runs on the group calendar
Firm G payroll onboarding has not started and will need its own plan once the completion date is confirmed
Judith Wilson and Nils Bergstrom will confirm the list of G employees who will transfer, with their start dates, before onboarding begins

slides.title: IT and SharePoint migration
bullets: Each firm's local share is kept as an archive root, with no content merged into the group estate
Leaver folders have been identified for each firm but ownership has not been confirmed for all of them
Items in the September tracker are open unless the tracker says otherwise; none of the unresolved items should be reported as complete
IT will not move a leaver folder until a named owner has checked its contents

slides.title: LIMS consolidation
bullets: The common export dictionary is agreed and the fields in it are fixed for the first release
Local accession numbers are kept for every firm, so there is no renumbering of existing samples
Reviewer comments on the export fields are still open and will be closed before the plan is finalised
Cutover dates for firms A to F and the mapping for firm G are still to be set
slides.notes: The draft plan is v3. Version 4 should not be circulated until the reviewer comments are closed.

slides.title: Osterquill: held apart until completion
bullets: Osterquill Toxicology completes its acquisition on 1 October 2026
Its archive stays outside the integrated repository until access rights and QA mapping are agreed
No Osterquill files are to be moved, renamed or restyled during the hold
Scientific and quality leadership at Osterquill will stay in place through the first phase, with a joint review of its records after completion

slides.title: Decisions for steering members
bullets: Agree that the price harmonisation working file stays at v4 until group finance signs off the normalisation assumptions
Confirm that firm G onboarding waits for the QA mapping and access review before any data is moved
Ask Yasmin Farhat to set the quality review dates for Osterquill records
Ask Andrea Beckett to confirm the group finance dates for the first post-completion reporting cycle

slides.title: Actions and next steps
bullets: Owners to update their workstream returns by the end of September
Price workbook owners to close the open [TBC] items for Quenverell, Westravelle and Durnesswick
SharePoint leaver folder owners to confirm ownership before the next tracker snapshot
LIMS team to close reviewer comments and circulate the v4 plan for comment
Next steering session in October, after the Osterquill completion date
